definitions.explanation: Refers to an item or thing, often with a judgmental or evaluative nuance. Frequently used in negative or critical contexts to describe something of questionable quality or character.

examples.japanese: ⟦とんでもない→とんでもない：03470_tondemonai⟧{代物|しろもの}だ。
examples.english: It's an outrageous piece of work.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{代物|しろもの}だ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: This is quite something, isn't it?

examples.japanese: ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦かなり→かなり：01149_kanari⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧{代物|しろもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかまされた。
examples.english: Being cheap, I ended up getting stuck with a pretty terrible piece of junk.

notes:
Almost always carries an evaluative tone — the speaker is passing judgment on the quality or nature of the item. Most commonly used in negative contexts (⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧{代物|しろもの}, ⟦とんでもない→とんでもない：03470_tondemonai⟧{代物|しろもの}), but can also express impressed surprise (⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{代物|しろもの}).

Not interchangeable with neutral words like ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ or ⟦{品物|しなもの}→品物：00886_shinamono⟧, which lack this judgmental nuance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦とんでもない→とんでもない：03470_tondemonai⟧{代物|しろもの} — an outrageous thing
- ⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{代物|しろもの} — quite an impressive thing
- ⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧{代物|しろもの} — a terrible piece of junk
- ⟦{大|たい}した→大した：03392_taishita⟧{代物|しろもの}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ — nothing special
